checks.mandatory_repository_gate: pass: lint, typecheck, compiled build, sequential full suite, empty baseline allowlist

known_limitations: The frozen corpus is synthetic and tests the harness's curated operational-memory use case, not general personal memory.
Honcho used normalized mean-pooled XTR vectors because its pgvector path accepts one vector per message; Pickbrain used Witchcraft's native XTR retrieval.
The existing local model server processes were excluded from Honcho service memory, while Honcho's API, deriver, Postgres, Redis, and two relays were included.
